findings.issue: Auth validation text uses light accent.coral (#ef7a6b) rather than the readable semantic error role. On its #F7F9FB opaque input/page surface, static contrast is 2.60:1 for 12pt error copy. Border at line 89 reuses it. This bypasses the darker error roles already defined in theme/tokens.ts.
findings.remedy: Use a scheme-aware semantic error foreground for validation text and a dedicated error border role; preserve validation/auth behavior.
findings.diagnostic: Static sRGB luminance calculation, not runtime/device verification: #ef7a6b / #F7F9FB = 2.60:1; existing #DC2626 = 4.58:1.

findings.issue: The color prop is applied before variantStyles; bodySm and label variants override it with textSecondary. A live settings profile label requests textPrimary but receives textSecondary unless its style independently overrides color.
findings.remedy: Resolve the variant base first, then explicit color and style; keep existing variants as adapters into one canonical role scale.

findings.issue: Inline detail values have neither flexShrink nor bounded width, while labels absorb remaining width. Long service/practitioner/date strings or large text can push icons/labels out of the summary card. Values also omit the locale textAlign/writingDirection used by labels. This is the summary primitive in the reference confirmation screenshot.
findings.remedy: Define responsive InfoRows: fixed icon, bounded label column, shrinkable/wrapping value with locale prose alignment, and stacked fallback at narrow width/large text. Keep dates/amounts under an explicit bidi contract.

findings.issue: Typography is split across sawaaType (display32/heading24/subheading18), ThemedText (36/20/16), SawaaText (24/16) and arithmetic adjustments in headers. ScreenHeader/SectionHeader render 20pt while SectionHeader documents 18pt. Font/line height changes do not propagate through one system.
findings.remedy: Choose canonical mobile semantic roles: display, pageTitle, sectionTitle, body, supporting, caption, action, numeric. Map legacy ThemedText variant names into those roles and remove local arithmetic from shared primitives.

findings.issue: AppTheme exports shared legacy radius values (pill6/card14/btn10), while newer components use Sawaa pill999/lg20/xl24. Shared numeric spacing and Sawaa named spacing match core steps but expose separate contracts; consuming theme.radius perpetuates a different geometry.
findings.remedy: Make mobile semantic radius/spacing aliases resolve to Sawaa definitions; retain compatibility names during migration. Default content card20/24, control capsule, input20 should follow the approved design instead of silently modifying every old shared token.

findings.issue: ThemedButton secondary is visually identical to primary, and its small square CTA differs from the PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton capsule system. StateMessage duplicates its own outline action and EmptyState uses a third CTA. A live practitioner card uses small ThemedButton.
findings.remedy: Unify one mobile action implementation with explicit primary/secondary/tertiary/destructive intents and size roles. Keep existing exports as wrappers; do not replace native Apple Pay.

findings.issue: PrimaryButton and SecondaryButton have no pressed feedback or loading/busy prop; ThemedButton and ThemedCard scale even when Reduce Motion is enabled. GlassSurface honors that preference, so shared interactions differ by import.
findings.remedy: Use one press-state hook/contract: disabled, busy, selected, pressed, reduceMotion, hit target and optional haptic. Reduced-motion feedback should use nonmotion color/opacity; pending action disables repeat submission and announces busy.

findings.issue: Core actions have fixed height 56 and Text can scale; long Arabic labels or large accessibility text can extend beyond the capsule. SecondaryButton similarly uses fixed height, while ScreenHeader is permanently one line. GlassSegmented sm is line16 + vertical16 =32pt, below other controls’44pt target.
findings.remedy: Use minHeight plus vertical padding and wrapping labels, scalable header layout, and min44pt segments. Define bottom-area measurement rather than a fixed guessed reservation; validate on small devices and large text.
findings.limit: Clipping/touch behavior inferred statically; no large-text render was run.

findings.issue: Password visibility toggle announces only the field label, so screen-reader users cannot identify show/hide state. Error text is not announced; this input has no focus border, while unused ThemedInput has focus treatment but tiny unlabelled suffix and no default label link.
findings.remedy: One input primitive should provide translated visibility action/state, error announcement, focus role, meaningful accessibility label, 44pt suffix, and caller event composition. Keep existing form state and validation contracts.

findings.issue: StatusPill uses system fontWeight without bundled IBM fontFamily. Avatar initials do likewise; ThemedButton obtains regular IBM family then requests600 instead of selecting the bundled weight alias. Other primitives explicitly use the correct alias.
findings.remedy: Use a canonical Text role/helper with getFontName(locale,weight) in every shared component, including pills, avatar initials and buttons. Keep numeric role explicit; audit mixed Arabic/English/date samples.

findings.issue: Staff verification banner uses a physical row rather than useDir.row; dismiss target is16+8=24pt and lacks accessible role/name, resend lacks a minimum target and pending/success/error status.
findings.remedy: Mirror via useDir, share44pt icon/button controls and inline async status. Any resend behavior change requires separately scoped auth approval; presentational geometry and labels can be planned independently.

findings.issue: FloatingCta requires each caller to reserve roughly160pt manually. Actual height depends on safe area, number of actions, text scale and labels; FloatingActionBar exposes a different absolute-action API. This invites hidden final content or excess blank space across screens.
findings.remedy: Create a shared screen scaffold with safe-area header/content/footer slots. Measure footer height and expose a content inset; support keyboard avoidance. Preserve screenshot full-width payment hierarchy and native Apple Pay geometry.

findings.issue: Exported SawaaButton/SawaaCard/SawaaText objects are static light-only styles and include hardcoded white/black; they claim branding support but no production consumer was found. GlassWebLayers, GLASS_CFG, getSawaaGlassAppearance, getBrandingTokens and FloatingActionBar similarly have no runtime consumer in audited search. These competing public paths risk reintroducing outdated visual policy.
findings.remedy: Deprecate/trim only after repository import audit; route documented entry points to theme-aware primitives. Keep Glass as a compatibility alias to GlassSurface.

findings.issue: ThemeProvider fetches PublicBranding and rebuilds the theme on branding changes, but buildTheme intentionally ignores branding colors. Mobile CLAUDE says runtime branding colors are authoritative; source and tests explicitly enforce fixed Sawa colors. Unifying styles must resolve this policy conflict without accidentally restoring legacy blue/lime.
findings.remedy: Document the approved fixed-color mobile contract; keep logo/content branding separate. Do not wire arbitrary provider colors into semantic contrast roles unless the design explicitly changes.

findings.issue: Every content-size change forcibly scrolls to locale start, potentially moving users away from the current carousel selection when data or text size changes.
findings.remedy: Anchor only on initial mount/locale change or preserve current logical scroll offset on dynamic updates; retain current locale mirroring contract.
findings.limit: Interaction risk is static inference; no device scroll journey was performed.

findings.issue: Financial-result screen is a non-scrolling flex View containing a 112pt icon, title/subtitle and up to five InfoRows while reserving 180pt for absolute FloatingCta. Small phones, long Arabic text or increased font size can overflow behind actions with no way to scroll.
findings.remedy: Use shared scrollable status-screen shell, reserve measured CTA height plus safe-area bottom; preserve phase/retry/payment reconciliation logic.

findings.issue: Profile surface receives loading only. Catalog request failure becomes noServices and disabled booking; practitioner request failure shows generic text without retry. Both authenticated and public profile callers discard query isError/refetch.
findings.remedy: Pass explicit practitioner/catalog request states and retry callbacks into the shared profile view; distinguish failed, loading, unavailable and genuinely empty scoped catalog. Keep clinic/service scope unchanged.

findings.issue: Native checkout falls outside the existing visual system: plain 24px/fontWeight title, no localized font/directional alignment, no shared ScreenHeader, and transparent rectangular bare action rows instead of shared actions. Arabic status copy aligns by native default.
findings.remedy: Wrap app-owned header/status/actions with ScreenHeader, localized typography/useDir, PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton and consistent surface spacing. Preserve the Apple Pay/CreditCard SDK components and callback/reconciliation semantics.

findings.issue: Legacy/resume payment route and bank-transfer use standalone BackButton + bespoke headings and a manual 52pt gradient CTA/absolute positioning while current confirmation uses centered ScreenHeader/PrimaryButton/FloatingCta. This creates inconsistent typography, hit sizes, loading state and bottom spacing.
findings.remedy: Use shared screen header and common footer/actions for app-owned presentation, retaining all capability/resume/upload conditions.

findings.issue: Packages use solid small-radius custom actions, small credit book buttons and text retry rows; booking and groups use full pill actions. Primary semantics, sizing and busy states vary across related journeys.
findings.remedy: Use shared primary/secondary/compact actions with explicit disabled/busy accessibility; keep selection, entitlement and mutation guards unchanged.

findings.issue: Unselected booking-option forward indicator always renders ChevronRight in both directions, unlike directory cards and headers. It points backward in Arabic RTL.
findings.remedy: Resolve ChevronLeft/ChevronRight using useDir, matching other forward actions.

findings.issue: Selected branch is indicated only by Glass variant and a thin teal border; no accessibilityState selected or radio role. Branch retry is a text-only Pressable without minimum target.
findings.remedy: Adopt shared selectable surface with radio/selected state, stable border width, stronger check/selection cue and >=44pt retry target.

findings.issue: Legacy payment chooser shows a border/check for selected method but omits accessibilityRole radio and selected state. The submit and bank-transfer submit Pressables also omit role/disabled/busy semantics.
findings.remedy: Apply shared selectable surface and action components with accessibility state, preserving availability and submit gates.

findings.issue: Public detail has only spinner + generic load-error text when item is absent. Service practitioner-query failure is rendered as empty practitioners. None of these failures has an in-place retry despite neighboring list and clinic routes providing retries.
findings.remedy: Use common request-state UI with separate error/not-found/empty and scoped retry callbacks; never widen missing clinic/service data.

findings.issue: Home drops up-next/therapist/clinic/package sections when their queries fail with no local error indication. A user cannot distinguish no appointment/balance/catalog from an outage; only pull refresh remains.
findings.remedy: Add compact recoverable section error states and stable loading placeholders using common request-state components; avoid inventing counts/availability.

findings.issue: Arbitrary CMS image is covered by only 2%-16% dark scrim, yet title/description are white. Bright images can make copy unreadable; a one-pixel shadow does not guarantee legibility.
findings.remedy: Give image copy a stronger shared contrast scrim/solid backing and verify representative bright/dark images; retain original image and destination.

findings.issue: Appointment detail uses entrance animations unconditionally although nearby list/booking/home screens respect useReduceMotion. Package booking also leaves TimeSlotsGrid reduceMotion at false.
findings.remedy: Propagate useReduceMotion consistently to owned animation consumers.

findings.issue: Time cells use 31.5% width plus two 8pt gaps. At 288pt content width (320pt phone with 16pt gutters) three cells need 288.16pt, so a nominal three-column row can wrap to two. Fixed text sizing also needs large-font verification.
findings.remedy: Use gap-aware flex-basis or measured grid width, allow safe row/cell height growth and verify 320pt Arabic + accessibility font size.

findings.issue: Hero always places a fixed 120pt image beside the name/rating/tags. On a 320pt phone, gutters, padding and gaps leave approximately 80pt for text; rating row does not wrap. Long practitioner names and increased font size can overcrowd or overflow.
findings.remedy: Use responsive portrait size/stacked hero below a width threshold; make rating/tags wrap and retain untruncated important identity.

findings.issue: Credit book action hardcodes alignSelf flex-start in Arabic too. The locked-reason text at lines 43 and 59 omits directional alignment.
findings.remedy: Use useDir alignStart/textAlign and shared compact action; preserve credit eligibility and lock reasons.

findings.issue: Explore uses independent 16/18pt radius surfaces, a bare TextInput instead of DirectorySearch, and 40pt filled retry colored using palette ramp rather than action role. Directory and explore states/cards look different for the same entities.
findings.remedy: Consume common directory/search/request-state/selectable tokens with app-owned forward semantics; avoid separate local palette-derived buttons.

findings.issue: Reference screenshot and current source describe different visual/interactions: screenshot has total before payment section, native white Apple Pay plus two outlined direct actions; current source uses method-selection Glass radios followed by total and a floating Pay action. The SDK Apple Pay button exists on separate native-checkout screen.
findings.remedy: Adopt screenshot colors/surface/typography/outline hierarchy as reference after explicit design choice. Do not move native SDK/direct-pay interactions or alter booking/payment execution in a visual pass.

findings.issue: Public package/program lists use generic ServiceRow, while client lists have PackageCard/GroupCard with richer price/session/capacity hierarchy. Guests lose comparable visual context.
findings.remedy: Define shared compact/full entity card variants across public/client lists using data already exposed; keep auth continuation and enrollment recovery unchanged.

findings.issue: Dark mode deletion confirmation text uses ink[900] (#e8f4f2) over coral fill (#ffa599): deterministic contrast 1.68:1. The danger action becomes difficult to read in the requested dark palette. Backdrop also borrows the near-white dark ink ramp.
findings.remedy: Add shared destructive-action fill/foreground and scrim roles; consume them in deletion sheet without changing deletion semantics. Shared sheet should support accessible modal semantics and large type.
findings.evidence: static token pair + local luminance calculation; no device render

findings.issue: Employee client query consumes only data/isLoading. Network/server failure produces the same noClients/noResults UI as an empty successful response, with no retry.
findings.remedy: Use shared query-state/EmptyState error variant and refetch action, preserve successful search/list behavior.

findings.issue: Availability fetch failure replaces schedule with seven empty days; after native error alert closes, screen displays every day as off and editable-looking switches, with no persistent failure/retry. Save is hidden, but failed data appears like a valid schedule.
findings.remedy: Show persistent shared error state and retry, disable/hide schedule editing while loadFailed; keep existing save/service contract.

findings.issue: Profile editing is inside a plain ScrollView with no KeyboardAvoidingView or automatic keyboard inset configuration. Lower fields/save may be covered by the keyboard on small phones.
findings.remedy: Give shared settings/form scaffold a keyboard-safe mode using the existing auth pattern, safe-area scroll padding and handled taps; verify lower fields/save on iOS and Android.

findings.issue: Profile edit control has a fixed 32pt height and no hitSlop; visual compactness also makes the interaction target compact.
findings.remedy: Use a shared compact action with a minimum 44pt press target and a separate 32pt visual pill.

findings.issue: OTP screen uses a non-scroll flex View despite keyboard-safe wrapper; fixed header/icon/boxes/actions can exceed available height with keyboard, landscape or large accessibility text. Suspended state is similarly non-scroll.
findings.remedy: Move auth status/code pages onto shared scrollable keyboard-aware scaffold; keep single native OTP autofill input and backend-required code lengths intact.

findings.issue: Client account/profile, records and notifications animate entrance unconditionally; employee screens respect useReduceMotion. Records also staggers all up-to-50 items, delaying late content by about 3s.
findings.remedy: Use shared motion helper that honors reduce motion and caps stagger delay; keep data and ordering unchanged.

findings.issue: Password recovery and reset remain Arabic-only through hardcoded titles, field labels, validation errors, CTAs and alerts, although surrounding app supports English. They also use fontWeight without Sawaa locale font and separate large-title headers.
findings.remedy: Adopt translated auth copy, locale fonts, shared pushed-screen header/form layout; preserve validation and reset API semantics.

findings.issue: Profile fields use custom raw inputs with no fontFamily/writingDirection. Phone/email are aligned right in Arabic like names; review-login always uses Arabic input font even in English. Email-entry, login, recovery, and profile forms implement distinct input focus/error/font treatments.
findings.remedy: Consolidate a locale-aware shared form-field component with text/email/phone/password/code modes, explicit numeric/email LTR direction, locale font, error announcements and consistent focus/disabled surface. Preserve each form rule.

findings.issue: Pushed settings/profile/notifications/video/employee-client screens use raw router.back with no cold-link fallback. Several may be entered without stack history through deep links; records and employee appointment already use goBackOrHome.
findings.remedy: Apply explicit role-owned fallback in shared pushed-screen scaffold/header callbacks; auth steps should retain flow-specific continuation/back semantics.

findings.issue: Push preference pending/error disables the switch but the row has no loading/error/retry explanation. Failure looks like an off preference that cannot be changed.
findings.remedy: Use shared preference-row states: loading indicator, persistent localized failure/retry, and disabled state announcement. Preserve permission handling.

findings.issue: Start/complete/cancel CTAs do not consume their mutation pending flags; after confirming the native alert there is no button loading/disabled feedback while request runs.
findings.remedy: Connect shared button pending/disabled presentation to existing mutations and show localized progress; preserve all action eligibility and permission logic.

findings.issue: Record navigation Pressable has no button role or combined accessible label; retry control has no minimum height and record metadata uses ad hoc 10.5/11.5/12.5 sizes.
findings.remedy: Use shared accessible history/appointment row with button role, combined date/service/practitioner label, type tokens, 44pt retry action and visible loading/empty/error templates.

findings.issue: Equivalent guest sign-in prompts use different CTA systems: account custom 50pt rounded-17 outline vs appointments shared PrimaryButton; page/card insets also differ 18/20 vs 16. Login/suspended each duplicate their outline action while employee has another OutlineButton.
findings.remedy: Promote secondary/outline button plus guest sign-in prompt card into shared Sawaa UI; standardize page gutter/card spacing/CTA height/radius while retaining deliberately different emphasis.

findings.issue: Summary loading/error/missing data all render dashes and no persistent message or retry; only pull-refresh lets user recover. Data is not fabricated, but state meaning is unclear.
findings.remedy: Give shared summary block loading skeleton, neutral missing-value display, localized error/retry and preserved stale-data behavior.

findings.issue: Email verification request failures are explicitly silent. Send action is text-sized without minimum touch area/accessibility role/state.
findings.remedy: Use shared banner action with pending, success, error/retry and accessible 44pt target; preserve role visibility conditions and request semantics.

findings.issue: Employee about/version is hardcoded Arabic and 1.0.0 while client Settings resolves native version/build from Constants; same app gives different version presentation across roles.
findings.remedy: Share locale-aware About section/version formatter from client settings with staff profile.

findings.issue: Join eligibility/countdown is memoized from Date.now with no clock state; a screen left open before the window can remain disabled after it opens. Video screen also computes hero state on render only.
findings.remedy: When video feature is explicitly activated, use one shared time-aware state hook for hero/CTA, retaining backend eligibility and host/client rules; keep disabled flag unchanged during visual work.

findings.issue: Video fetch errors collapse into bookingNotFound and offer no retry. Join URL opening errors are swallowed, leaving no feedback.
findings.remedy: Before enabling video, use shared distinct loading/error/not-found state and URL-open failure feedback; preserve provider and role semantics.

findings.issue: Video action uses fixed-height 56 gradient and physical LTR icon row with literal bilingual labels; separate from PrimaryButton/OutlineButton. Large-font text may clip, and Arabic icon order differs from other controls.
findings.remedy: Before enabling video, render timing-specific label through shared locale-aware button with minHeight, horizontal padding, wrapping and i18n keys.

findings.issue: Client native tab layout omits labelStyle with locale fontFamily; guest and employee native tab layouts supply getFontName(dir.locale, 500). Shared tab style supplies only tint and icon colors, so client tab typography depends on native defaults.
findings.remedy: Centralize locale labelStyle in shared native-tab configuration and consume it consistently across all role shells; confirm Arabic/English native rendering. Keep RTL ordering and route names intact.

No code/docs/dependency/database/auth/permission mutations; no tests/build/lint/commits/pushes/deployments. Unrelated dirty mobile release docs were observed and preserved.

contracts: ThemeProvider remains the single scheme/mode owner; do not add Redux theme state or change auth/server-data ownership.
Use semantic scheme-aware foreground/surface/action/selection/error roles; palette numbers are primitives, not UI intents. Do not reuse theme.colors.primary mint as white-label fill.
One typography function resolves role size/lineHeight/weight/font alias and bidi. Legacy ThemedText variant exports adapt during migration; caller color must win.
One Button contract supplies intent,size,label,icon,disabled,busy,onPress and accessible state. Existing PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton/ThemedButton wrap it until screens migrate.
Keep native Apple Pay/provider payment views and financial/auth/business logic untouched in a theme migration.
GlassSurface is the one surface renderer. Preserve material=surface default opaque; material=glass opt-in for navigation. Do not treat historical clear/regular names as evidence of translucency.
